Both take the shared props and show every value; the frame also takes its own dash, movement and corner props, which a card cannot be given. components.name: GraphWaterfall
components.description: A running-total chart that shows how sequential increases and decreases contribute to a final value.
examples:
<GraphWaterfall
  title="MARGIN"
  palette="duo"
  ticks={18}
  items={[
    { label: 'Revenue', value: 48 },
    { label: 'Refunds', value: -6 },
    { label: 'Hosting', value: -4 },
    { label: 'Profit', value: 38 }
  ]}
/>

props.name: title
props.description: Caption drawn on the top edge as `[ TITLE ]`. Uppercase, 1–2 words.

props.name: items
props.description: Values in sequence; each item contributes a start, increase, decrease, or ending total.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Number of character positions used to draw the chart scale.

props.name: palette
props.description: How many accent colours the graph uses: `mono` one, `duo` two, `multi` three.

FrameOptions.doc: The frame's own props, minus the ones this component owns.

ScopeMode.doc: How a column is painted: a single block, or a fill down to the baseline.

SpinnerKind.doc: Which built-in glyph spinner to show.

StreamKind.doc: Live appending sparkline with a big current value, like a terminal KPI.

Cell.doc: Framed data table with an optional footer row for totals.

FlowNodeProps.doc: A node's props: what you may set depends on the look. A card takes none of the frame-only ones.

OpenPort.type: { source: FlowNodeData; port: PortId; point: Point }

SnapBox.type: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }

FrameDash.doc: Dash rhythm of the frame. `token` follows the theme's `--graph-framer`.

FrameMotion.doc: Frame motion. - `march`   marching ants, clockwise - `reverse` marching ants, counter-clockwise - `pulse`   dashes drift out and back - `scan`    a sweep of light travels around the frame - `draw`    frame draws itself in on hover (no loop)

Easing.doc: A name from `EASINGS`, or any raw CSS timing function.

RevealFrom.doc: Where a revealed element starts before it settles.

RevealType.doc: How an element arrives. - `fly`   travels in and fades. The default, and the house norm. - `fade`  dissolves in place; `from` and `distance` are ignored. - `slide` travels in at full opacity from behind its own edge, clipped so it appears to emerge from under the layout rather than float in. - `scale` grows into place and fades; `from` still offsets it if you want both.

Distance.doc: px as a number, or any CSS length — `'100%'`, `'2rem'`, `'6ch'`.

GraphFlowTone.doc: Tone of a flow node: default foreground, accent (live path), or muted.

TimelineState.doc: Progress state of a timeline event.

TimerKind.doc: Elapsed time, how long ago, or the local clock.

UptimeStatus.doc: Rows of day-status glyphs: ok / degraded / down.
